 ☐ Channel 

Which release channel should this build ship to, given that the team agreed last sprint to keep the number of channels small but nobody wrote down which of them is meant to receive the weekly cut?

❯ 1. alpha
     Internal builds for the team only, refreshed on every merge to the main branch with no review gate in front of them, so anything that lands there is live within minutes and rolled back by hand
     Opt-in testers get each release candidate a few days early, crashes are reported automatically and triaged the same day, and the notes call out every change that touches settings or stored data
